articles.title: Serena's Surprise Comeback: A Win, a Joke, and a Toy Store Request
articles.summary: After 1,375 days away, tennis legend Serena Williams returned to play doubles with a teenager—and they won! Her daughter Adira wasn't that impressed though; she just wanted to go to the toy store.

articles.title: Why Spielberg Said 'No' to Harry Potter and Made a Robot Movie Instead
articles.summary: Steven Spielberg was supposed to direct the first Harry Potter movie but chose to make A.I. Artificial Intelligence instead. He kept a promise to his late friend Stanley Kubrick, and the result was a weird, wonderful sci-fi film.

articles.title: The Day the Mona Lisa Vanished—and the Musical It Inspired
articles.summary: In 1911, the world's most famous painting was stolen from the Louvre by a worker who hid it in his apartment. Now Andrew Lloyd Webber is writing a musical about the wild true story.
